TEXT: The next day...

We arrived at Kinkaku-ji Temple, the Golden 
Pavilion.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: It is really gold in color... It's so beautiful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It has a different sort of majesty than Ginkaku-ji 
Temple. To be honest, I like that Silver Pavilion 
better...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Really?

When the sunlight hits the temple here, it does look 
almost mythical. Still, despite the beauty of it all, it 
just doesn't click with me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I heard that due to economic issues, they didn't 
stick silver foil onto Ginkaku-ji. Even if they did, it 
wouldn't compare to the gold at Kinkaku-ji.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: But you still prefer it, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

Even so, I still like Ginkaku-ji Temple better. It's 
elegant in its own right. Well... I guess I just like 
plainer things.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: You're amazing, Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nah, it's not like I've said anything of value.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I mean, you actually still remember something you 
studied.

Well, Manami and I spent such a long time studying 
this stuff. Like I'd just forget it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I remember back when we were studying for 
entrance exams together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah...

Thanks to Manami's help, the harsh revisions for the 
entrance exams weren't as bad as I thought.
